changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0045. Tenant-scoped gym communications (announcements, circulars, offers, events, alerts). Index review: PK on each Id; IX_Communications_TenantId_Status_PublishAt for admin lists and member feeds; IX_Communications_TenantId_Type for type filters; IX_CommunicationAudienceMembers_CommunicationId and IX_CommunicationAudienceMembers_MemberProfileId for selected-member targeting; UX_CommunicationReads_CommunicationId_UserId for unread checks. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId. Soft-deleted rows stay filtered out. Member category targeting is deferred until members carry a category FK.
